## Checklist
- [ ] No trajectories (`*.lammpstrj`), executables or files above 5 MB
- [ ] No existing run folder under `simulations/` was edited or deleted
- [ ] Scripts use relative paths only
- [ ] Any cluster size quoted says which definition it uses (q6 bond-order / CNA / PTM) and which run, frame and cycle
- [ ] No copyrighted material (paper PDFs, book code) and no personal data
